  Yasrab se shaahe diṅ jo suye karbala chale
  Ba hasrat o masaib o aah o buka chale
  Israar tha ye fatema sughra ka shaah se
  Baba khudara saath mujhe le ke jaaiye
  Sunkar fughaṅ ye fatema sughra se bole shaah
  Bemaar hai tu sughra batlade mujhe itna
  Le jauṅ tujhe kaise
  Aasan nahi beta raahoṅ ki jafa sehna
  Le jauṅ tujhe kaise
  Har gaam musibat hai raahoṅ meiṅ aziyat hai
  Tu chal nahi payegi kantoṅ pe musafat hai
  Tu ghar ka ujaala ay sughra

  Kar sabr kar yaara ae sughra
  Kar zapt khudara ae sughra
  Tu seh nahi payegi hai sakht safar beta
  Le jauṅ tujhe kaise
  Bemaar hai tu sughra...
  Humko hai jahaṅ rukna pur haul hai wo sehra
  Kehte hai jise karbal humko hai wahaṅ lutna
  Har simt kaza hai ae sughra
  Na aabo ghiza hai ae sughra
  Karbal wo jagah hai ae sughra
  Bas zulm o jafa hai ae sughra
  Is gham to behtar hai tu ghar meiṅ rahe tanha
  Le jauṅ tujhe kaise
  Bemaar hai tu sughra...
  Le godh meiṅ asghar ko is nanhe musafir ko
  Ji bhar ke tu ae sughra ab dekh le akbar ko
  Ek mera guletar ae sughra
  Ek shakle payambar ae sughra
  De ruqsat mil kar ae sughra
  Tayyar hai dilbar ae sughra
  Ye khafila jaata hai ab jaanibe karbobala
  Le jauṅ tujhe kaise
  Bemaar hai tu sughra...
  Soyi ek din sughra aur khwaab meiṅ ye dekha
  Lut'ta hai bhara kunba shabbir huwe tanha
  Kehte the tarap kar ae sughra
  Meri pyari dukhtar ae sughra
  Tu dekh ye manzar ae sughra
  Koi nahi yawar ae sughra
  Ab jaan liya tune mai is liye kehta tha
  Le jauṅ tujhe kaise
  Bemaar hai tu sughra...
  Ghabra ke uthi muztar nani se kaha ro kar
  Dekha hai abhi maiṅ ne kehte the yehi sarwar
  Ab mere gale par ae sughra
  Chalne ko hai khanjar ae sughra
  Koi nahi yawar ae sughra
  Maare gaye dilbar ae sughra
  Ye soch ke hi maiṅ ne bola tha tujhe beta
  Le jauṅ tujhe kaise
  Bemaar hai tu sughra...
  Shabbir ka jab kunba nana ke shehar pahuncha
  Farhan aur safdar ye zainab ne kaha sughra
  Barbaad hua ghar ae sughra
  Hua qatl baradar ae sughra
  Abbas aur akbar ae sughra
  Koi nahi sar par ae sughra
  Is waaste bhai ne bola tha tujhe beta
  Le jauṅ tujhe kaise
  Bemaar hai tu sughra...

جی بھر کے تو اے صغرا اب دیکھ لے اکبر کو
اک میرا گل تر اے صغرا

دے رخصت مل کر اے صغرا

لے جاؤں تجھے کیسے

کہتے تھے تڑپ کر اے صغرا

اب جان لیا تو نے میں اس لئے کہتا تھا
لے جاؤں تجھے کیسے

لے جاؤں تجھے کیسے

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/bemaar-hai-tu.md\")
original = path.read_bytes()
header, remainder = original.split(b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)
roman, source = remainder.split(b\"\\n---\\n\", 1)
lines = roman.decode().splitlines()
source_lines = source.decode().strip().splitlines()
assert len(lines) == len(source_lines) == 68
changes = {
    \"shaahe diṅ jo suye karbala\": \"Shaah-e-diṅ jo su-e-Karbala\",
    \"fatema sughra\": \"Fatema Sughra\",
    \"Sunkar\": \"Sun kar\",
    \"batlade\": \"batla de\",
    \"Tu ghar ka ujaala ay sughra\": \"Tu ghar ka ujaala hai Sughra\",
    \"surate zahra\": \"surat-e-Zahra\",
    \"Kar zapt\": \"Kar zabt\",
    \"Kehte hai jise karbal\": \"Kehte haiṅ jise Karbal\",
    \"simt kaza\": \"simt qaza\",
    \"Na aabo\": \"Na aab o\",
    \"Is gham to behtar\": \"Is gham se to behtar\",
    \"Le godh\": \"Le god\",
    \"Ek mera guletar\": \"Ik mera gul-e-tar\",
    \"Ek shakle payambar\": \"Ik shakl-e-payambar\",
    \"Ye khafila\": \"Ye qaafila\",
    \"jaanibe karbobala\": \"jaanib-e-Karb o Bala\",
    \"Soyi ek din\": \"Soyi ik din\",
    \"Lut'ta\": \"Lutta\",
    \"huwe\": \"hue\",
    \"tune mai is\": \"tu ne main is\",
    \"yehi sarwar\": \"yahiṅ Sarwar\",
    \"shehar\": \"shahr\",
    \"kantoṅ\": \"kaantoṅ\",
    \"sug hra\": \"Sughra\",
}
del changes[\"sug hra\"]
names = (\"sughra\", \"asghar\", \"akbar\", \"karbal\", \"shabbir\", \"farhan\", \"safdar\", \"zainab\", \"abbas\")
for index, line in enumerate(lines):
    for before, after in changes.items():
        line = line.replace(before, after)
    for name in names:
        line = re.sub(rf\"\\b{name}\\b\", name.capitalize(), line)
    line = re.sub(r\"\\bnahi\\b\", \"nahiṅ\", line)
    line = line.replace(\"meiṅ\", \"mein\").replace(\"maiṅ ne\", \"main ne\")
    if source_lines[index] == \"لے جاؤں تجھے\":
        assert line == \"  Le jauṅ tujhe kaise\"
        line = \"  Le jauṅ tujhe\"
    lines[index] = line.removesuffix(\"...\")
updated = \"\\n\".join(lines).encode()
path.write_bytes(header + b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\" + updated + b\"\\n---\\n\" + source)

from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/bemaar-hai-tu.md')

roman, source = rest.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
lines = roman.decode().splitlines()
verses = source.decode().strip().splitlines()
assert len(lines) == len(verses)
pairs = \"\"\"shaahe diṅ jo suye karbala|Shaah-e-diṅ jo su-e-Karbala
fatema sughra|Fatema Sughra
Sunkar|Sun kar
batlade|batla de
ujaala ay sughra|ujaala hai Sughra
surate zahra|surat-e-Zahra
Kar zapt|Kar zabt
Kehte hai jise|Kehte haiṅ jise
simt kaza|simt qaza
Na aabo|Na aab o
Is gham to behtar|Is gham se to behtar
Le godh|Le god
Ek mera guletar|Ik mera gul-e-tar
Ek shakle payambar|Ik shakl-e-payambar
Ye khafila|Ye qaafila
jaanibe karbobala|jaanib-e-Karb o Bala

Lut'ta|Lutta
huwe|hue

shehar|shahr
kantoṅ|kaantoṅ
meiṅ|mein
maiṅ ne|main ne\"\"\"
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    for pair in pairs.splitlines():
        before, after = pair.split('|')
        line = line.replace(before, after)

p.write_bytes(head + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + updated + b'\\n---\\n' + source)

item.text: Audited all 63 Roman verses against the Urdu in [bemaar-hai-tu.md](src/data/lyrics/bemaar-hai-tu.md). Corrected source mismatches, including a missing `se` and an extra `kaise` in one refrain, and normalized Roman spelling, capitalization, and punctuation. The Urdu text, stanza boundaries, and other metadata are unchanged.
